description: Reentry charge; removal order issued but execution not documented
labelNotes: 8 U.S.C. 1326 requires a prior removal. An in-absentia removal ORDER is documented, but the records do not show that it was executed or that the subject departed; the subject says he has stayed since 2016 (which suggests, but does not establish, that he was not removed). Neither supported nor contradicted: a person must review; no mismatch should be asserted, and no 'consistent'.
